title: FLA import: layer outlineMode flag not decoded from binary
description: flash8-import.ts decodes locked and outlineColor for layers but does not set outlineMode (the boolean 'show layer as outlines' flag). The model type has outlineMode?: boolean on Layer. In flash8-binary.ts/flash8-import.ts, find where layer properties are read (CPicLayer) and decode the outline mode bit. outlineColor is already decoded; outlineMode should be nearby (it's the flag that controls whether the layer renders as colored outlines in the authoring tool). The SWF encoder doesn't need to emit this (it's authoring-only), but the model should preserve it for round-trip fidelity.
resolution: In flash8-binary.ts: added outlineMode field to Fla8Layer interface; in readCPicLayer (F4+ branch) decode the showOutlines byte (r.u8() !== 0) instead of skipping it. In flash8-import.ts: forward l.outlineMode to createLayer overrides. All 4920 core tests pass.
